name: Obzervi Logs
author: DigiFlow NYC

sections.description:
Obzervi is a comprehensive WordPress activity log plugin designed to help site administrators, agencies, and security professionals monitor exactly what is happening on their websites. By keeping a detailed audit log of user actions and system events, you can instantly detect suspicious activity, streamline troubleshooting, and enforce accountability across your team.

Whether you run a multisite network or a membership community, tracking user activity is crucial for maintaining security and accountability. Obzervi keeps a clean, lightweight activity log with a modern dashboard, and offers optional Pro features such as AI-powered analysis and IP security.

Why You Need an Activity Log

  • Detect suspicious access by recording failed login attempts.
  • Troubleshoot site issues by knowing exactly what changed before an outage.
  • Hold your team accountable by always knowing who changed what, and when.
  • Keep a long-term audit trail of administrative actions across your site.

Free Features

Everything below is included in the free plugin:

  • Real-time activity log dashboard showing user and system events as they happen.
  • Core event tracking: post and page edits, user actions, logins and logouts, failed login attempts, user role changes, plugin and theme changes, settings updates, and media uploads.
  • Activity timeline and trends, automatically categorized by event type.
  • Top Critical Actions panel highlighting the most important events from the last 24 hours.
  • Powerful filtering and search by user, date, and event type.
  • Log retention controls with automatic purging of old entries.
  • Role-based access control over who can view the activity log.
  • System health overview: total log volume, active tracking coverage, and database storage usage.

Pro Features

Upgrade to Obzervi Pro to unlock advanced security and analysis:

  • AI-Powered Insights: one click and AI analyzes your recent activity, spotting unusual patterns, summarizing what happened, and recommending actions.
  • IP Security & Blocking: tiered IP banning (2 hours → 6 hours → permanent), subnet blocking for IPv4/IPv6, and whitelist/blacklist controls.
  • IP Geolocation: see the geographic origin of each logged action.
  • Content History & Diffs: see exactly what changed in any post or page, side by side, with detailed change context for every event.
  • Integrations: send activity notifications to Slack and by email.
  • Weekly email report summarizing your site’s activity.
  • Top Active Users: identify who is most active and who is currently online.
  • Advanced analytics with interactive charts and detailed breakdowns.
  • Cloud backup: keep an off-site copy of your activity logs.
  • Export your activity log to CSV for reporting, audits, or documentation.

Learn more about Obzervi Pro at https://obzervi.com/.
sections.installation:
Install from the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Search for ‘Obzervi’.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’ and wait for the process to complete.
  4. Click ‘Activate’ to turn on the plugin.
  5. Access the Obzervi dashboard to view your real-time activity log.

Install Manually

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress repository.
  2. Navigate to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ and click ‘Upload Plugin’.
  3. Select the downloaded ZIP file and click ‘Install Now’.
  4. Click ‘Activate’ once the installation is successful.
sections.faq:
Does Obzervi slow down my website?

No. Logging happens asynchronously and the dashboard loads data only when you open it, there are no heavy queries running on every page load. The optional Pro IP blocking layer is also extremely lightweight and runs at the earliest point in the request lifecycle.

What data is recorded for each logged event?

For every action tracked, the plugin records the exact date and time, the user and their specific role, the source IP address from which the change originated, and the specific object or setting that was modified.

Can I export my activity log data?

Yes. You can export your audit log records to a CSV file for external reporting, compliance audits, or internal documentation.

Can Obzervi help with compliance and audits?

Yes. Obzervi maintains a detailed, timestamped audit trail of administrative actions on your site, and you can export your activity log to CSV for compliance reviews, security audits, or client reporting.

Does Obzervi replace the WordPress error log?

No, they serve different purposes. The WordPress error log (debug.log) captures PHP errors and warnings for developers. Obzervi captures user and system events for site owners and admins. The two complement each other: error logs tell you when code breaks, Obzervi tells you who triggered it and what they were doing.

Does the plugin track failed login attempts?

Yes. Tracking failed logins is a core security feature of Obzervi, helping you identify and mitigate brute-force attacks or unauthorized access attempts quickly.

What does AI-powered WordPress monitoring actually do?

AI-Powered Insights is an Obzervi Pro feature. The AI engine reads your activity log and flags patterns a human would miss, a user logging in from two countries an hour apart, an admin editing 40 posts in five minutes, a sudden spike in failed logins from a single subnet. The free version records the events; the Pro AI layer tells you which ones matter and why.

How is Obzervi different from other AI WordPress plugins?

Most AI plugins generate content text, images, summaries. Obzervi Pro uses AI to analyze your site’s behavior, surfacing security anomalies, unusual admin activity, and suspicious access patterns, combining activity logging, AI analysis, and IP blocking in a single plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.48

  • Updated: Freemius SDK bumped to 2.13.4.

1.0.47

  • Fixed: Administrators could be blocked from the plugin dashboard right after activation (“Sorry, you are not allowed to access this page”).
  • Improved: Content history diff now handles very large content without exhausting memory.

1.0.46

  • First public release on WordPress.org.
  • Core activity tracking for posts, pages, users, plugins, and themes.
  • Dedicated database table structure for performance optimization.
  • CSV export of the activity log.
